reference_role: Subject, chocolate materials and photo style guide; original preserved.

assets.name: nut-bark
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: one isolated chocolate bark piece for an animated website hero. Input image 1 is a subject/material/photo-style reference, not a composition to copy: the final output must contain only ONE separate bark shard, not the stacked tower. Match the reference's appetizing photoreal chocolate, natural nuts/inclusions, rich brown tones, glossy highlights and irregular broken edges. Studio macro product photography, crisp high detail, soft upper-left light. Show the whole piece, including all broken edges, at a three-quarter elevated angle so both top face and thickness are visible. Centered large on a square transparent canvas with at least 8 percent clear breathing room on every side. True alpha transparency. No cast shadow, no drop shadow, no floor, no plate, no background, no text or branding, no hands, no detached crumbs or extra pieces. Subject: one broad irregular triangular piece of milk chocolate bark, with clearly recognizable hazelnut halves and almond pieces embedded through its broken front edge and subtly visible on the top, inspired by the lower nut-filled layers in the reference. Its top face is fairly smooth and gently rippled, with a natural asymmetrical silhouette. The long edge runs roughly lower-left to upper-right.
